mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_categories AS ( SELECT id FROM categories WHERE visible = 1 AND ((#{categoryId} IS NULL AND parent_id IS NULL) OR id = #{categoryId}) UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM categories child JOIN visible_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.visible = 1 )

FROM shops s WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_categories c STRAIGHT_JOIN products p FORCE INDEX (idx_products_shop_status_category) ON p.shop_id = s.id AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.category_id = c.id )
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_categories AS ( SELECT id FROM categories WHERE visible = 1 AND parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM categories child JOIN visible_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.visible = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT c.id, category.name FROM visible_categories c JOIN categories category ON category.id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' WHERE p.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY c.id
